record.bible_text: Then answered<WH06030><WTH8799> Zophar<WH06691> the Naamathite<WH05284>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>,

<FI> Yet<Fi> he shall perish<WH06><WTH8799> for ever<WH05331> like his own dung<WH01561>: they which have seen<WH07200><WTH8802> him shall say<WH0559><WTH8799>, Where<WH0335> <FI>is<Fi> he?

The eye<WH05869> also <FI>which<Fi> saw<WH07805><WTH8804> him shall <FI>see him<Fi> no more<WH03254><WTH8686>; neither shall his place<WH04725> any more behold<WH07789><WTH8799> him.<CM>

His children<WH01121> shall seek to please<WH07521><WTH8762> the poor<WH01800>, and his hands<WH03027> shall restore<WH07725><WTH8686> their goods<WH0202>. <RF>His children...: or, The poor shall oppress his children<Rf>

<FI> Though<Fi> he spare<WH02550><WTH8799> it, and forsake<WH05800><WTH8799> it not; but keep it still<WH04513><WTH8799> within<WH08432> his mouth<WH02441>: <RF>within...: Heb. in the midst of his palate<Rf>
<FI> Yet<Fi> his meat<WH03899> in his bowels<WH04578> is turned<WH02015><WTH8738>, <FI>it is<Fi> the gall<WH04846> of asps<WH06620> within<WH07130> him.

The heaven<WH08064> shall reveal<WH01540><WTH8762> his iniquity<WH05771>; and the earth<WH0776> shall rise up<WH06965><WTH8693> against him.
The increase<WH02981> of his house<WH01004> shall depart<WH01540><WTH8799>, <FI>and his goods<Fi> shall flow away<WH05064><WTH8737> in the day<WH03117> of his wrath<WH0639>.
